description:
Live UK grant funding calls from GOV.UK Find a Grant in one call: name, funder, amount range, opening/closing dates, who can apply, one-line summary and the official source link. Filter by keywords, nation, applicant type and amount band. Indexed daily from the official listing - the service has no API of its own, so this is the machine-readable version.

Costs $0.10 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet). Returns: result = { total_matched, returned, grants[] of { id, name, funder, amounts{min,max,text}, window{opens,closes,open_now,days_to_close}, who_can_apply, org_types, regions, summary, criteria_parsed, criteria_basis seed|llm|listing|null, source_url }, excluded{} }.

max.description: Only grants whose minimum award is at most this many GBP.

min.description: Only grants whose maximum award is at least this many GBP.

open_now.description: Default true: only grants currently open for applications. Set to false to include closed/not-yet-open listings.

org_type.description: Applicant type: individual, business, charity, community_group, public_body, local_authority, education (synonyms like sole-trader, cic, council are mapped).

q.description: Keywords matched against grant names, summaries, funders and descriptions (light stemming). At least one criterion is required.

region.description: UK nation: england, scotland, wales, northern-ireland (or uk for UK-wide only).

name: uk_grants_search
title: Search live UK grants
